name: weightedSd
title: Weighted variance and weighted standard deviation

origin.description: Computes a weighted standard deviation of a numeric vector.
origin.details: weightedSd is the square root of weightedVar. The variance uses sum(w * (x - center)^2) / (sum(w) - 1). A negative variance, from a weight sum below 1, has square root NaN.

translation.description: Computes a weighted standard deviation of a numeric vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: One-dimensional numeric vector. This is x in R.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: A vector of weights the same length as x. None gives every original element weight 1. Passed through to weightedVar.

arguments.name: idxs
arguments.text: 1-based subset of elements. None means no subsetting.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If True, points whose x is missing are skipped. This is na.rm in R.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: Optional numeric center passed to weightedVar. None estimates the center from the filtered weights.

translation.details: The result is the square root of weightedVar. R's NA stays R's NA. A negative variance becomes NaN.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.weightedvar import weightedSd

weightedSd(np.arange(1, 11, dtype=float))
